# Arpita Mehta, Presence Consultant, Delhi

> Presence consultant in Delhi working across four disciplines (image, executive presence, social culture, and AI for branding and business) for executives, founders, brides, graduates and homemakers. Over ten years in marketing before moving into presence work. Holds a City & Guilds Certificate in Soft Skills (City and Guilds of London Institute, UK), a WSET Level 1 Award in Wines (Wine & Spirit Education Trust, London), and is a Certified Image Consultant and Certified Train the Trainer through ICBI (Image Consulting Business Institute, India). Four licensed cohort programmes run roughly twice a year; one-to-one consulting runs year-round. Based in Delhi, works online with clients across India and internationally.

## What a presence consultant does, and how this differs

Most coaches work on mindset. Most stylists work on clothes. Most etiquette consultants work on rules. This practice works on all of it at once, because a room experiences all of it at once. The integration is the differentiator, and it comes from over ten years in marketing, a City & Guilds Certificate in Soft Skills, a WSET Level 1 Award in Wines, image consulting and train-the-trainer certification through ICBI, an engineering background, and the specific ability to see how four signals combine into a single impression.

The four signals, which are also the four dimensions the Presence Quotient measures:

1. Image: how you are read before you speak.
2. Executive Presence: how you are read when you do.
3. Social Culture: how you are read across a table rather than a desk.
4. Distinction: whether, afterwards, anyone can describe what makes you specifically memorable.

- Engineering degree.

## Who this is for

Executives, founders, managers, brides, homemakers, graduates, doctors, lawyers, pilots, teachers, diplomats, and people entering a new chapter of any kind. The common thread is not an industry or a life stage. It is a gap between who someone is and how the world currently sees them, and the decision to close it.

This is consulting and training, not therapy, not mindset coaching, and not a personal shopping service.

## The Presence Quotient

A proprietary self-assessment created by Arpita Mehta. Sixteen questions, roughly four minutes, free to take. It returns a score out of one hundred, a band, and a private scorecard naming which of the four dimensions is costing the person most. It is the usual starting point before a paid session. Take it on the [assessment page](https://arpitamehta.co/assessment.html).

## The four licensed programmes

Each runs as a licensed cohort roughly twice a year, and each is also available as one-to-one consulting, in person in Delhi or online. Group and corporate training is quoted separately.

- The Presence Edit: image consulting, built the way a brand identity is built.
- The Executive Edge: executive presence for people who are already good, where competence is assumed and presence is the tiebreaker.
- The Social Table: wine, dining and social culture, including a dedicated chapter for brides and couples.
- The Debut: campus to corporate, for graduates and freshers making the first ninety days deliberate. Also delivered as campus workshops.

## One-to-one sessions and prices

All three are booked and paid for on the [booking page](https://arpitamehta.co/booking.html). Payment is taken first, then the client chooses a time on the calendar that follows.

- Discovery Call: ₹339, 15 minutes, online, available anywhere in the world. A conversation to work out whether the practice is the right fit.
- Video Consultation: ₹2,049, 45 minutes, online, available anywhere in the world. Where the discovery call decides whether to work together, this one does the work: image, how you read on camera and in a room, and the single gap costing you the most.
- In Person Consultation: ₹4,299, 1 hour, face to face in Delhi. You leave with three things to change that month, and a written summary follows within two days.

Group programmes and corporate training are quoted separately; see the Services page.

Free to reschedule with at least 24 hours' notice. No refund inside 24 hours or for a no-show. Full refund or a free reschedule if Arpita cancels. Full policy: [cancellations and rescheduling](https://arpitamehta.co/faq.html#cancellation-policy).
